notes: Main is the near-centre N-S street; west of Main only the part south of Allison (blocks 3 and 4, Walnut to Main) is drawn, north of Allison is the sheet-151 reference outline (Melindy is not shown, so no Main/Melindy point). Street names: 'ALLISON' is printed here; it is 'E. 14TH (ALLISON)' on sheet 151, so named East 14th Street. 'E. 13TH' west of Main (58 ft) and 'E. 13TH (WOODWARD)' east of Main (40 ft) are both named East 13th Street; they meet Main at two T points ~163 px apart. 'WOODWARD (FRANKLIN)' (50 ft) is named Woodward Street. Long Alley is printed only between Webster and Engine Alley ('ALLEY'/'LONG', 13 ft printed near Woodward); the 10 ft alley in line with it from Liberty to Webster, and the alley in line south of Woodward to East 13th (continuing onto 147), are given the same name. On sheet 156 the alley north of Liberty is also printed 'LONG ALLEY', but it is offset ~31 px east of the alley south of Liberty, so Liberty has two Long Alley T points. Likewise Cogswell Alley is printed only between Webster and Woodward; the 10 ft alley in line from Liberty to Webster and the 10 ft alley south of Woodward (to East 13th, continuing on 147) carry the same name; it is 'COGSWELL ALLEY' north of Liberty on 156, aligned within ~12 px, so a cross. The unnamed 15 ft E-W alley inside block 6 (Long Alley to Cogswell Alley, crossed by Yokon Street at ~2874,3786) is listed under alleys only. Bracket Alley north of 13th is centred ~870, the 146 stub south of 13th ~890 (two T points). Hughes Street centreline is angled NNE; its point is where the extended centreline meets Liberty's centreline. Sheet is slightly skewed: Main centre drifts from ~2045 at Orchard to ~2070 at East 13th, Sycamore from ~3648 to ~3675. Widths: East 13th is 40 ft east of Main; Long Alley 13 ft at Woodward.
